info.text:
The Met Gala raised $42 million in one night.

It funds the Costume Institute, the only curatorial department at the Met that must fund itself.
The gala raised $16.4M in 2021 and a record $42M in 2026. Tickets went from $75,000 (2025) to $100,000 (2026).
IRS rule: only what you pay above an item's fair market value counts as a donation, and for payments over $75 where you get something back, charities must tell you in writing what's deductible.

Sources: WWD, Fortune, CBS News (May 2026); AP; IRS Publication 1771.
News and education, not financial advice.
